en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an alpine valley with a rocky stream in the foreground, crossed by a small wooden or metal bridge. On the right, atop a steep hill, stand the ruins of a medieval castle with a prominent, square keep or watchtower surrounded by trees and crumbling walls. In the lower left inset, there is a second view of a tree‑lined path or road running beside the stream toward the same bridge. The print has scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
